phase1_dependency: Jeju-only racefit run models and selected experiment prediction outputs were removed under cleanup_plan.json; current champion and its gate records remain verified.

dataset_cache_assessment.audit_effect: Removing dataset payloads leaves data/experiments/model_runs.jsonl untouched; audit_artifacts.py checks dataset manifests (retained) and old artifact_path files (already disposed in phase 1).
dataset_cache_assessment.rebuildability_limit: This audit confirms no live champion dependency and that manifests identify the cached feature tables; it does not run a fresh dataset builder or prove that each table can be byte-for-byte rebuilt from raw sources.

noncandidate_sources.experiment_code_snapshots: All `reproduce/` files are outside this manifest and deferred to the dependency-aware source/docs audit.
noncandidate_sources.current_champion_evaluation: The transition-holdout directory is outside phase 2, including its champion/gates and three retained frozen baseline prediction parquet files.
noncandidate_sources.research_feature_and_source_datasets: The top3/transition/H3 feature directories remain preserved because their source-history lineage is valuable for the data-first restart; direct inference only reads the four paths named above.
noncandidate_sources.docs_and_generated_markdown: Root-level docs and data/experiments/reports are outside this phase; the delegated legacy review preserves concise conclusions and updates references.

known_side_effects: The phase-1 removal of 13 old Jeju run model artifacts leaves historic artifact_path entries in the shared data/experiments/model_runs.jsonl. The shared ledger is intentionally unchanged; scripts/audit_artifacts.py will continue reporting those old artifacts missing.
Five removed parquet payloads are not separately checked by scripts/audit_artifacts.py, but deleting them prevents rerunning those old Jeju racefit studies without rebuilding their feature caches.
execution_constraints: Wait for explicit root approval of this exact manifest before phase-2 deletion.
Before execution, verify each listed path hash and byte size, no symlink traversal, registry/champion/input/gate hashes, and confirm the 3 held-out baseline tables still exist unchanged.
Delete only exact listed files; preserve manifests, source history, operational databases, data/predictions, and every file outside this allowlist.
